title: A PBR grid for strings and frets: metalness x roughness, standard against physical
question: Which metalness and roughness make nickel frets and wound strings read as metal under a studio environment, and what does GA's MeshPhysicalMaterial (clearcoat, sheen) cost over MeshStandardMaterial?
hypothesis: Materials of the same type with different values share one program in WebGPURenderer; MeshPhysicalMaterial adds programs and shading work.
